name: Dueling Grounds ⚔️
desc:
⚔️ Fast-paced PvP fighting game where you fight with various weapons to become the strongest. Claim your place at the top!

The game is Available on PC, Mobile and Console

PC CONTROLS (You can change them in settings)

M1 / M2 - Light / Heavy Attack
F - Parry / (Hold) Block
Q or Shift - Dodge
M3 or T - Lock to Enemy
Ctrl - Mouse Lock / Unlock
Space - Jump
R - Ultimate
